items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: I played with the bear originally too when he had the Young Turks here at the Hour Club.

ctx.x: I'm trying to think, is that originally any relation to the old time trombone?

Oh, just to remind you. I played with the bear originally too when he had the Young Turks here at the Hour Club. He did. You know, this one took, uh, uh, Lil Armstrong came down at the Suburban Garden.
